title: Gula Melaka
subject: an old Melaka couple trading pantun over who forgot to buy gula melaka for the kenduri cendol
caption: Dondang sayang, the traditional Melaka pantun duet, in an acoustic stage style. A solo violin opening with a short ornamented melody and answering every sung line, rebana frame drums keeping a slow swaying 4/4, a soft gong marking the end of each pantun, and an accordion holding quiet sustained chords underneath. Sparse and acoustic, a roomy wooden-hall sound, the violin and both voices forward, percussion light and behind. Male and female duet trading four-line pantun, gentle and ornamented with cengkok turns, teasing and conversational, older voices with warmth. 68 BPM, D minor. A long marriage, bickering sweetly. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no harmonium or tabla, no keroncong ukulele, no pop chorus build, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - solo violin, short ornamented phrase]

[Verse 1 - Female]
Pergi ke Jonker membeli tembikar
Singgah sebentar di Bukit Cina
Santan dah perah, api dah besar
Gula Melaka, abang, mana?

[Verse 2 - Male]
Anak ikan di Sungai Melaka
Berenang jauh ke Pulau Besar
Abang terlupa, bukan sengaja
Terleka berbual di tepi pasar

[Chorus - Duet]
Gula Melaka, oh gula Melaka
Tiga puluh tahun, masih juga terlupa
Sudip di tangan, Jah tunggu di tangga
Abang balik bawa cucur, bukan gula

[Verse 3 - Male]
Pokok kelapa di Tanjung Kling
Daunnya melambai ditiup bayu
Abang ke kedai, motor dah pusing
Bawa gula, bawa bunga, Jah tersipu malu

[Bridge - violin alone, then the female voice, softer]
Bunga melur di dalam pasu
Disiram pagi, harum ke senja
Tiga puluh tahun Jah dah tahu
Abang lupa memang sengaja

[Chorus - Duet]
Gula Melaka, oh gula Melaka
Tiga puluh tahun, masih juga terlupa
Sudip di tangan, Jah tunggu di tangga
Esok abang lupa lagi, Jah ikut sama

[Outro - violin and gong, slow ending]
